syntax.method: transpileModule only; no import resolution, typecheck or mounted runtime

validation.mountedTests: UNRUN: explicitly forbidden in implementation subtask
validation.typecheck: UNRUN: explicitly forbidden graph; transpile does not resolve types/imports
validation.preHandoff: UNRUN: requires committed checkout; no checkout edits or commits authorized
validation.network: No runtime executed. Tests install a rejecting guard and assert zero fetch attempts; no successful service behavior is simulated.

limitations: Six proposed cases are not execution evidence or complete access acceptance.
Native operating-system picker/UI, provider authentication/publication, paid operations and geometry computation are outside scope.
Only no-model prerequisites and local configuration are asserted; historical loaded/federated child behaviors remain separate evidence.
No production gap found blocking the four named routes by pinned source inspection.

cleanup.note: Only retained deliverable/evidence scratch created. No redundant nonempty helper files or generated workspace to release; all original jobs, source, locks and fixtures preserved.
